segments.text: > Part of the [Implementation Status](README.md) index. `crypto.subtle` is Node's own `lib/internal/crypto/webcrypto.js` in TypeScript (`lib/node/internal_crypto_webcrypto*.ts`), written over the `node:crypto` module, whose natives come from the crypto library selected with `-crypto`: OpenSSL 3 libcrypto (default, all platforms) or Apple CommonCrypto + Security.framework (`-crypto=commoncrypto`, macOS only, out of scope) ([TDD-00104](../tdd/TDD-00104.md)). `crypto.getRandomValues`/`randomUUID` need only a real CSPRNG (`arc4random_buf`/`getrandom()`), no external library.

caveats: A whole `ArrayBuffer` is accepted as a deliberate extension (real JS throws `TypeMismatchError` — only integer TypedArrays are spec-legal) ([ADR-00554](../adr/ADR-00554.md))
notes: The spec's 65,536-byte quota is enforced — an oversize view throws `QuotaExceededError`; a float TypedArray (`Float32Array`/`Float64Array`) is a compile-time rejection, matching the spec's `TypeMismatchError` ([ADR-00554](../adr/ADR-00554.md))
Fills any integer TypedArray/`ArrayBuffer` in place and returns it ([ADR-00317](../adr/ADR-00317.md)); the legacy plain-`number[]` form (one random byte value per element) still works
See [ADR-00024](../adr/ADR-00024.md)
RFC 4122 version-4 UUID string
See [ADR-00024](../adr/ADR-00024.md)
SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 over any BufferSource → `Promise<ArrayBuffer>`; an unknown name rejects with `NotSupportedError`

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide
notes: AES-CTR (`counter`, `length`), AES-CBC, AES-GCM (`iv`, `additionalData`, `tagLength`) and RSA-OAEP (`label`), with Node's errors; a failure rejects with `OperationError`
See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md)

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide
notes: HMAC, RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, RSA-PSS (`saltLength`), ECDSA (P-256/P-384/P-521, IEEE P1363 signatures) and Ed25519
See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md)

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide
notes: AES-CTR/CBC/GCM/KW, HMAC, RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5/RSA-PSS/RSA-OAEP (any `publicExponent`), ECDSA/ECDH, Ed25519 and X25519; usages checked and split across a pair as Node splits them
See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md)

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide
notes: `raw` (secret keys; EC points, compressed or not; Ed25519/X25519), `pkcs8`, `spki` and `jwk` for every algorithm, with Node's JWK checks (`kty`, `crv`, `alg`, `ext`, `key_ops`, `use`) and member order; `CryptoKey.type`/`extractable`/`algorithm`/`usages`
See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md)

Node's lib/internal/crypto/hash.js in TypeScript over the backend's incremental digest contexts: every digest the backend has (`shake128`/`shake256` with `outputLength`), Node's argument validation and error codes (`ERR_CRYPTO_HASH_FINALIZED`, `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`, `Digest method not supported`)
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)
caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: `md5`/`sha1`/`sha224`/`sha256`/`sha384`/`sha512` only — SHAKE, SHA-3, SHA-512/t, RIPEMD-160 and BLAKE2 throw `Digest method not supported`

notes: Every cipher the backend has, with `setAutoPadding`, and `setAAD`/`getAuthTag`/`setAuthTag` for AEAD modes; key/IV length errors and `bad decrypt`/`Unsupported state or unable to authenticate data` as Node reports them
`getCiphers`/`getHashes` list what the linked OpenSSL can fetch, as Node lists its own (so a system OpenSSL 3.0 lists `des3-wrap` where Node's bundled 3.5 lists the `-wrap-pad` aliases)
caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: AES-128/192/256 in CBC, ECB, CTR and GCM only — other ciphers throw `ERR_CRYPTO_UNKNOWN_CIPHER`

notes: The callback forms run on the thread pool, as Node's do
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)
caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: the digests are the six `createHash` has there

notes: `randomBytes`/`randomFill` callbacks run on the thread pool; `randomInt` is Node's rejection-sampling loop
See [ADR-01300](../adr/ADR-01300.md)

caveats: `dh` key pairs are not generated (`rsa`, `rsa-pss`, `dsa`, `ec`, `ed25519`, `ed448`, `x25519`, `x448` are)

On `-crypto=commoncrypto`: RSA keys of 1024 bits or more with exponent 65537, EC keys on P-256/P-384/P-521, `ed25519` and `x25519` only; encodings other than SPKI/PKCS#8 PEM and the `padding`/`saltLength`/`dsaEncoding` sign options fail
notes: Without an encoding a pair is two `KeyObject`s; an encoding may be `pem`/`der`/`jwk` with `pkcs1`/`spki`/`pkcs8`/`sec1` and a `cipher`/`passphrase`. A key may be a `KeyObject`, PEM or `{ key, passphrase, padding, saltLength, dsaEncoding }`
Generation runs on the thread pool in the callback form

caveats: A `secp256k1` JWK cannot be imported (P-256/P-384/P-521 can; export covers all four)
On `-crypto=commoncrypto`, creating or exporting an asymmetric key fails
notes: PEM, DER (`pkcs1`/`spki`/`pkcs8`/`sec1`, encrypted PKCS#8 with a passphrase) and JWK (RSA, EC, OKP) input; `export` in each; `type`, `asymmetricKeyType`, `asymmetricKeyDetails`, `symmetricKeySize`, `equals`, Node's errors and `ERR_OSSL_*` codes
See [ADR-01345](../adr/ADR-01345.md)

ECDH on every built-in curve with compressed/uncompressed/hybrid points and `ECDH.convertKey`; `diffieHellman` over EC, X25519 and X448 KeyObjects; the RSA functions with OAEP (`oaepHash`, `oaepLabel`), PKCS#1 and no padding, Node's errors and `ERR_OSSL_*` codes
See [ADR-01346](../adr/ADR-01346.md)
The global `crypto.subtle` works; the module does not re-export it

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide
notes: PBKDF2, HKDF (non-extractable base keys, as Node requires), ECDH and X25519; `deriveKey` to any key the algorithm can make

caveats: On `-crypto=commoncrypto` the asymmetric algorithms (RSA, EC, Ed25519, X25519) fail: they run over `node:crypto`'s KeyObject, which that backend does not provide
notes: Any exportable key in any format, wrapped with AES-KW, AES-GCM/CBC/CTR or RSA-OAEP
See [ADR-01347](../adr/ADR-01347.md)

rows.feature: `crypto.subtle.supports`, `getPublicKey`, `encapsulateKey`/`decapsulateKey` and the algorithms Node marks experimental (Ed448, X448, SHA-3, cSHAKE, KMAC, Argon2, AES-OCB, ChaCha20-Poly1305, ML-DSA, ML-KEM)
